name: wp-agentic
description: Bounded, evidence-gated autonomous delivery loop: 16 role agents (pm, architect, designer, lead, makers, reviewers, QA, security, scout, release), workflows (ship, feature-cycle, review-sweep, polish-sweep, research-sweep), guard hooks, deterministic gate scripts, ledgers and templates. Never stalls: frozen acceptance criteria, fingerprinted findings, capped fix rounds, escalation files with safe defaults.
